tokens.name: base
tokens.usage: The page and every band that is not the stage: header, breadcrumb row, edit panel, footer. Never pure white.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: The stage: the band where your screen, the camera preview and the video sit. Alternates with `base`, always separated by an `ink` rule.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Every raised surface: buttons (ghost), the capture dock, cards, dialogs, frame cells. Always outlined in `ink`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, button text, every 1.5px outline and rule, every offset shadow, the focus ring, icons. 16.6:1 on `base`, 15.9:1 on `sand`, 17.5:1 on `card`, 6.5:1 on `accent`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Body copy, captions, timecodes and meta lines. 8.9:1 on `base`, 8.5:1 on `sand`, 9.3:1 on `card`. Never on `accent`.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Decorative only: skeleton blocks and the progress track. Never a meaningful edge (1.2:1 on `base`).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative only: dividers between rows inside one card.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Tangerine, the one accent: primary button fills, progress fills, the countdown arc, the overview window, link underlines. Never text and never the only marker of state (2.6:1 on `base`). Text on it is `ink` (6.5:1).

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: The overview bar's visible window and a selected menu row. Ink text on it is 14.7:1.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destroys or stops: Stop, Discard, Delete selection, frames marked for removal, cut markers, a muted mic or camera. Text-safe: 6.0:1 on `base`, 6.4:1 on `card`; `card` text on it is 6.4:1. Darker than `accent` (2.4:1 apart) so the two never read as one.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind an off toggle (muted, camera off) and over frames marked for removal. `danger` text on it is 5.4:1; always paired with an icon change and a word.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind a toggle that is on with an effect (Blur on) and behind the Exported notice. Ink text on it is 14.5:1; always paired with a word.

tokens.name: rec
tokens.usage: The REC dot only, on an `ink` pill (4.6:1). Never text.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind an alert dialog: `ink` at 45%. No blur.

styles.name: meta

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Side padding of every band; card padding.

tokens.name: stack
tokens.usage: Gap between a screen's heading, paragraph and actions.

tokens.name: control-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row, and between the dock's controls.

tokens.name: target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every control. Large buttons are 52px.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: The app header.

tokens.name: breadcrumb-height
tokens.usage: The Editor's breadcrumb row.

tokens.name: cell-width
tokens.usage: A timeline frame at the closest zoom (0.2 s).

tokens.name: cell-height
tokens.usage: A timeline frame.

tokens.name: cell-gap
tokens.usage: Between timeline frames.

tokens.name: bubble-size
tokens.usage: Webcam bubble diameter as a share of frame height; 2.5% inset.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Buttons, the brand tile, video frames.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Notices, the details list in a dialog, menus.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and status lists.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: The capture dock and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, the progress bar, the webcam bubble.

tokens.name: radius-cell
tokens.usage: Timeline frames.

tokens.name: shadow-offset
tokens.usage: Every button and split button: a hard ink edge.

tokens.name: shadow-offset-sm
tokens.usage: Small round buttons (a cut marker's restore).

tokens.name: shadow-offset-press
tokens.usage: A hovered or pressed button, moved 2px down.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Things that float over the stage: dialogs and in-stage status cards.

tokens.name: stroke-outline
tokens.usage: Every outline and rule in `ink`.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring: solid `ink`, offset 2px.

tokens.name: stroke-current
tokens.usage: The playhead frame's outline in the timeline.
